writingRules.description: Máximo 1 o 2 párrafos concisos. Los reclutadores y hiring managers dedican menos de 10 segundos a una primera lectura.
Eliminar saludos acartonados como 'I hope this email finds you well' o frases serviles. Hablar de colega de ingeniería a colega de ingeniería.
1) Fit inmediato con el stack; 2) Valor medible entregado (Wells Fargo, json-to-compose, KMP); 3) Call to Action rápido.
NUNCA mencionar HansellApp. Fue un proxy comercial de agencia obsoleto. El rol actual es Wells Fargo desde 2025-01.

formAnswers.title: Why Us / Role Excitement
formAnswers.promptEn: Tell us a bit about why you're applying to work here. What excited you about this role?
formAnswers.promptEs: ¿Por qué quieres trabajar aquí? ¿Qué te entusiasma de este rol?
formAnswers.answer: With 11 years of mobile engineering experience across Android SDK, Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), and modular client architecture, I enjoy building the mobile platform foundations that let product teams ship cleanly and reliably. Having built tools like json-to-compose (a Compose Multiplatform rendering engine) and shipped daily with AI coding workflows, TDD, and CI, I can strengthen core platform architecture quickly.
formAnswers.guidance: Reemplazar genéricos por el nombre específico de la empresa si el formulario lo permite, manteniendo intacta la mención a KMP y json-to-compose.

formAnswers.title: Misión, Propósito e Impacto Social
formAnswers.promptEn: Tell us about our mission or purpose and what it means to you.
formAnswers.promptEs: ¿Qué significa para ti nuestra misión o propósito de impacto?
formAnswers.answer: Mission-driven software starts with building reliable mobile tools that remove everyday friction for real users. Because learning software engineering changed my own path, I started Academia Desde0 to teach Android and Kotlin in Spanish, where ~30 developers have started their careers. At work, that means caring about offline resilience, clear UI, and stability that people can count on daily.
formAnswers.guidance: Ideal para empresas con preguntas sobre impacto (Block/Cash App, Nubank, Uber, organizaciones fintech o de salud).

formAnswers.title: Liderazgo Técnico, Mentoría y Calidad
formAnswers.promptEn: Describe your technical leadership style and approach to mentorship.
formAnswers.promptEs: Describe tu estilo de liderazgo técnico y mentoría en equipos de ingeniería.
formAnswers.answer: As a senior engineer, I believe strong technical leadership is about multiplying the impact of those around you. Beyond architecting modular Android and KMP solutions, I have mentored 20+ engineers, taught TDD in Academia Desde0, and established collaborative pair programming and structured code reviews. I thrive in environments that value structured concurrency, continuous learning, and pragmatic velocity.
formAnswers.guidance: Resalta la multiplicación de impacto sobre la codificación individual aislada.

formAnswers.title: Experiencia en iOS y Cross-Platform (KMP)
formAnswers.promptEn: Do you have iOS development experience or cross-platform mobile expertise?
formAnswers.promptEs: ¿Tienes experiencia en desarrollo iOS o tecnologías multiplataforma?
formAnswers.answer: My cross-platform expertise centers on Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), enabling shared business logic, networking, and data layers between Android and iOS without runtime overhead. While my native deep-dive is Android SDK and Jetpack Compose, I routinely collaborate with iOS engineers to expose clean Swift-friendly APIs via SKIE, integrate CocoaPods/SPM dependencies, and maintain shared architecture across platforms.
formAnswers.guidance: Posicionar a Jesús como especialista en Kotlin Multiplatform que une ambos mundos, nunca como un 'novato en iOS'.

formAnswers.title: Autorización Laboral en EE.UU. (Visa TN)
formAnswers.promptEn: Work authorization, sponsorship requirements, and legal status in the US.
formAnswers.promptEs: ¿Requiere patrocinio de visa o autorización laboral en Estados Unidos?
formAnswers.answer: Yes, I require visa sponsorship via the TN Visa category (USMCA/T-MEC treaty for Mexican citizens). I currently reside in San Leandro, CA (SF Bay Area) and hold professional engineering degrees from IUT de La Rochelle and UTT. TN visa transfers/issuance take only 2-3 weeks with minimal employer paperwork and zero quota/lottery constraints.
formAnswers.guidance: En casillas de opción múltiple: 'Are you authorized to work in the US?' -> YES. 'Will you now or in the future require sponsorship?' -> YES (TN Visa).

formAnswers.title: Expectativa Salarial / Tarifa (Remoto México / Tijuana)
formAnswers.promptEn: What is your expected hourly rate or monthly compensation for remote work from Mexico?
formAnswers.promptEs: ¿Cuál es tu tarifa por hora o expectativa salarial para roles remotos desde México?
formAnswers.answer: $35–$55 USD/hour for multi-month contracts (or USD $5,600–$8,800/month full-time), invoicing directly from Mexico via Form W-8BEN.
formAnswers.guidance: Aplica para vacantes remotas desde México, nearshore o LATAM. Para roles presenciales/híbridos en EE. UU., revisar la banda publicada del puesto.
